in_hindi.name: Azin
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector
in_hindi.long_meaning: Azin एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Arabic root 'azana', which means 'to protect'. In Islamic tradition, Azin is a name given to a girl believed to be a protector and guardian, often used for daughters born to families with many sons.

In Islamic tradition, Azin is a name given to a girl believed to be a protector and guardian, often used for daughters born to families with many sons.
